_comment: Seasonal / annual recruitment programs, edited by hand. 'window' = latest known registration period (YYYY-MM-DD, either side may be null). 'auto' = name of a checker in programs.py that reads the official site on every run (null = manual only). 'checked' = when the manual info was last verified.

programs.name: MagangHub – Program Magang Nasional
programs.summary: National paid internship for fresh graduates at partner companies and government agencies, 6 months.
eligibility: Fresh graduate D3 / D4 / S1, graduated at most 1 year ago
Indonesian citizen with an active NIK
programs.benefit: Monthly allowance equal to the local minimum wage
programs.usual_schedule: Several batches a year (2026: July, September, late October)

programs.name: MAGENTA – Magang Generasi Bertalenta BUMN
programs.summary: Internships at state-owned companies. Each company opens its own postings throughout the year.
eligibility: Students and fresh graduates D3 / D4 / S1 / S2
Each posting sets its own requirements

programs.name: Rekrutmen Bersama BUMN (RBB)
programs.summary: Joint recruitment for permanent positions at many state-owned companies.
eligibility: Requirements differ per company and position – see the official announcement
programs.usual_schedule: Once a year; 2025 opened 7 March. 2026 dates were not confirmed in news sources.
programs.note: The official site can't be read automatically (SSL error), so check it yourself.

programs.name: CPNS & PPPK (civil servant selection)
programs.summary: Civil servant selection through SSCASN. IT formations include Pranata Komputer.
eligibility: CPNS: usually age 18–35 at the close of registration
Education and major depend on the formation
PPPK: check whether a formation is open to the general public
programs.usual_schedule: Varies per year. As of October 2026 the general CPNS 2026 schedule had not been announced.

programs.name: Magang Bakti BCA
programs.summary: Paid frontliner internship (Customer Service / Teller). Not an IT role.
eligibility: Age 18–24, unmarried, never joined Magang Bakti before
CS Pembukaan Rekening Online: D3/S1 with GPA ≥ 2.50, placement in Serpong, Tangerang or Semarang

programs.name: BRI – Brilian Banking Associate Program (BBAP)
programs.summary: BRI's e-recruitment portal. BBAP is its entry program, posted per region.
eligibility: See each posting on the portal

programs.name: BNI Officer / Assistant Development Program (ODP / ADP)
programs.summary: BNI's graduate development programs, posted on Kalibrr. Has had an IT track.
programs.usual_schedule: Several rounds a year (2026 rounds closed 26 April and 21 September)

programs.name: Bank Mandiri Officer Development Program (ODP)
programs.summary: Mandiri's graduate officer program, including an IT track. Recruited through a national hiring round.
eligibility: Fresh graduates – see the official announcement
programs.usual_schedule: National hiring early in the year (2026: registration until 6 March)
programs.note: No official page that can be read automatically was found; the link is a university announcement.

programs.name: PCPM Bank Indonesia
programs.summary: Pendidikan Calon Pegawai Muda: education program that leads to a permanent position at Bank Indonesia.
eligibility: S1 max. age 26 / S2 max. age 28 (Angkatan 41 rules)
